reviews.text:
On the night/early morning of September 7, 2026, I took my dog ​​to the emergency room at the clinic, where she was seen by Dr. Naiara Viegas.
I arrived with a 1-year-old Golden Retriever, who was more agitated than usual, and at home had been experiencing a lack of appetite, recently presenting with intense vomiting and urinary incontinence. The dog had severe Subaortic Stenosis, under post-surgical follow-up with the team of the wonderful Dr. Alexandre Bendas, and had a recorded history of her heart condition at the clinic. I, the owner, recorded her feeling unwell, showed it to the veterinarian, and informed her that she also suffered from gastric problems. The "professional" questioned what I was saying, alleged the possibility of giardia and that this was probably the case, said that the dog was slightly dehydrated and that, due to her active behavior (common in Golden Retrievers, and which proves nothing), she would not need hospitalization. She medicated and discharged her. At my request, a blood test was done.
The next day, seeing her burping, trembling, and crying again, I was desperate. The blood test results arrived in my email in the mid-to-late afternoon, showing liver and kidney abnormalities and dehydration. I was at work, I tried several times to call the clinic for guidance, and I rushed home to take my dog ​​to another emergency room. The surgeon who had operated on her had warned me of the need to put her on an IV drip due to her illness and abnormalities. I arrived home and found her lifeless.
The dog could have been alive if she had been hydrated intravenously, had more tests done, and been monitored and stabilized, but she was "alert" in the emergency room, wasn't she?
If I ever set foot in that clinic again, with my other dog, it will only be because of the excellent cardiologists who work there, Dr. Caren and Dr. Bendas, welcoming and sensational doctors, and the head anesthesiologist who sedated her for the echocardiogram.

Not even the reception staff gave me the proper feedback when I went to tell them what happened this week.

Nothing will undo what happened to us.
I was always well attended to and my pet was well taken care of. When he needed orthopedic surgery, he was also very well taken care of.
I stopped by to buy a little gift for my babies 🐶🐕. Lots of variety of things.
Excellent service and Dr. Hugo is super attentive, thank you for the care he showed my four-legged daughter!!!!
The clinic has highly qualified professionals in their respective fields, who are very caring, and the environment is very pleasant.

I've been going to IEMEV with my dogs for a while now and I've always felt very well received, from the moment I arrive to any exam or during hospitalization. I feel welcomed and confident with all the professionals I've seen. But I want to highlight Dr. Danielly Belmonte. You know when you think of a family doctor? Now bring that to the veterinary field. She is humane, welcoming, always willing to help, sensitive, extremely attentive to detail, and deserves all the praise a veterinarian can have. You can see how passionate she is about what she does and about our pets. I recommend her without hesitation.
